Ad: Kevin Trudeau on what an average person can do to shift their energy.

His first suggestion is to spend time around people or places with a very high frequency. He is clear that a bar or a rock concert does not count.

Instead, he points to a symphony, especially Baroque classical music, or being in the presence of a spiritually enlightened teacher. Kevin compares it to taking a shower: the environment lifts you and helps clear out some of the counter intentions.

It is a simple idea about choosing your surroundings on purpose.

What place or music leaves you feeling most uplifted?
#mindset #energy #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau tells a story from his school days.

As a kid, he thought the blurry blackboard was just how everyone saw it. Then a teacher sent him for an eye exam, he got glasses, and for the first time everything was crystal clear.

He says he had nothing to compare it against, so he never knew anything was off.

Kevin says it is the same with counter intentions. When you release them, you feel something you have never felt before.

What is something you only noticed once it changed?
#mindset #awareness #kevintrudeau
